what: While the Hero plate stuck to the screen scrolls one screen (span) from the very top of the document, it melts bound to scroll. The image shrinks 1 → .8x while blur goes 0 → 60px, the center logo shrinks to 30% and blurs 60px, and the whole plate fades from opacity 1 → 0. When fully melted, the next section behind (text over video) is revealed

options.fade: If off, the panel doesn’t turn transparent

use: Logo
note: The consuming side sets the panel to position: fixed (or sticky). The original uses the fixed panel as the trigger with top top → bottom top, so it ends up melting over the first screen — here it is set directly to document 0 → span screens.

from.where: index.html .j-fv — dark leather photo with a wordmark in the center
